EXCLUDING LIABILITY FOR INFRINGEMENT CLAIMS AS DISCUSSED IN SECTION 9 OF THIS AGREEMENT
findings.explanation: Your intellectual property infringement claims are carved out of your general liability cap and have no separate limit, exposing you to uncapped financial liability for those claims.
findings.suggested_change: eGain's total liability for all claims under this Agreement, including infringement claims, shall be subject to the limitation of liability set forth in Section 7.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, I am reviewing the contract and have one small point to discuss. Please see the note below regarding the agreement: - Regarding the relevant clause, intellectual property infringement claims are carved out of the general liability cap with no separate limit, which leaves liability uncapped. I propose that total liability for all claims under the agreement, including infringement claims, be subject to the standard limitation of liability. Thank you for your time and flexibility. Best regards,
